# Working Time Dashboard

A ready-made board in the Dashboards app (Human Resources section), installed
automatically with the Extended Attendance module.

## KPI cards
Worked Hours, Absence Days (scheduled day, no badge at all), Late Arrivals,
Overtime Hours, Utilization (actual vs planned), Punctuality (share of worked
days started on time). Value cards show the change vs the previous period.

## Charts
Worked Hours by Department, Absence Days by Department, Late Hours by
Department, Top 10 Late Arrivers, Top 10 Early Leavers, Top 10 Most Punctual,
Overtime by Department, Actual vs Planned Hours by Month.

## How to use
- Filters: Period, Department, Company.
- Cards and charts link to the daily measurement rows (Attendance -> Reports ->
  Extra calculations), where each day shows First In / Last Out, late minutes,
  overtime and night work.
- An "absence" is a scheduled working day with no attendance at all; weekends
  and days off are not counted.
